name: Zelophehad
overview: The account of Zelophehad's daughters in Numbers 27 reveals a significant moment where five daughters—Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah—approach Moses and the leaders to petition for their father's inheritance since he died without sons. They respectfully present their case before the congregation at the tabernacle, emphasizing that their father died in his own sin and was not part of Korah's rebellion, thus seeking to preserve his name within the family. Moses brings their request before the LORD, who responds directly, affirming the legitimacy of their claim. This passage highlights God's just provision in inheritance matters and underscores the importance of honoring family legacy even when sons are absent.
